shorts_extract.hook: Eugene fails to draw a single room of his house on paper, then stands up and walks straight to the kitchen snack cabinet.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Squire's 36-session amnesic habit tests (>85% accuracy without recall) paired with Graybiel's MIT T-maze recordings showing dorsolateral striatum start-and-end task-bracketing.
shorts_extract.twist: Optogenetic silencing proves old habits are never deleted from the striatum — they remain latent and snap back unless outcompeted by a replacement routine.
